bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
docker exec -i deploy-postgres-1 sh -c 'exec psql -X -q -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -At -F "|" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f -' <<'SQL'
SELECT p.message_thread_id,p.message_id,p.state,p.pinned,length(p.token_hash),m.state AS migration_state
FROM topic_dm_entry_pins p
JOIN startless_public_post_migrations m
ON m.kind='topic' AND m.chat_id=p.chat_id AND m.message_id=p.message_id
WHERE p.chat_id=-1003847210571
AND p.message_thread_id IN (102,104,116,1000,81,92,103,50,51,52)
ORDER BY p.message_thread_id;
SQL
echo OLD_LINK_SOURCE_AND_MIGRATION_READBACK_DONE
